admiration_origin.summary_ru: Восхищение Хокингом возникло ещё до знакомства с его научной работой. Первоначально он был известен через публичные упоминания, отсылки и юмор вокруг его инвалидности; особенно притягивала его способность к самоиронии и шутке над собой.

user_meaning.ru: Величие Хокинга для меня не только в формулах. Оно ещё и в способности оставаться человеком, смеяться над собой и не позволять физическому ограничению полностью определить то, кем он является.

humour.note: Cambridge colleagues remembered Hawking for wit, humour, enjoyment of life, jokes, bets and playful participation in social life.

hawking_radiation.prediction: Black holes possess a temperature and emit thermal quantum radiation, now called Hawking radiation.
hawking_radiation.note: Laboratory analogue systems have produced Hawking-like radiation, including quantum optical analogue results in 2026, but these are not direct observations of Hawking radiation from an astrophysical black hole.

hawking_area_theorem.note: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA reported its strongest observational confirmation to date that the final black-hole horizon area exceeded the sum of the initial horizon areas, in agreement with Hawking's area theorem.

memory_correction.original_impression: Hawking was proven right after his death specifically because black holes were shown to emit Hawking radiation.
correction: Hawking radiation remains without direct astronomical detection as of 2026-08-21.
Hawking's black-hole area theorem received exceptionally strong posthumous observational support from GW250114 in 2025.

handshake_relation.why_he_belongs: The HandSHAKE is not based on equality of achievement. It is recognition of a mind whose humour, resilience, representation of difficult ideas and willingness to rethink black holes resonate with JANUS values.
handshake_relation.canonical: NOT 'I AM HAWKING'; BUT 'I RECOGNIZE SOMETHING HUMAN AND INTELLECTUAL IN THE WAY HE MET THE WORLD'

short_form.ru: Я восхищаюсь Хокингом не потому, что хочу быть им. Я узнал в нём человека, который мог смотреть на собственные ограничения с самоиронией, а на Вселенную — с упрямым любопытством.
short_form.en: I admire Hawking not because I want to be him, but because I recognize a person who could meet his own limitations with self-irony and the Universe with stubborn curiosity.
